item.title: Defender P1: How Many Exist?
item.description: How many Microsoft Defender products are there? Which one do you actually need? A practitioner's guide to the Microsoft Defender family, Endpoint, Office 365, Identity, Cloud Apps, XDR, and more. Written by a CISO for CISOs, IT managers, and security professionals navigating Microsoft 365 E5 licensing.
